question: The piston rings are placed in the ring groove and provide sealing between which of the following two parts to prevents leakage of high-pressure gases?
solution:
The correct answer is __Piston and the cylinder liner.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Piston rings__ are placed in the ring grooves of the piston and play a crucial role in engine operation.
 
• They provide sealing between the piston and the cylinder liner to prevent leakage of high-pressure gases.
 
• Piston rings ensure that combustion gases do not escape into the crankcase and maintain optimum engine compression.
 
• They assist in heat transfer from the piston to the cylinder wall, helping in engine cooling.
 
• The piston rings also regulate oil consumption by scraping excess oil off the cylinder walls while maintaining lubrication.
 
• Proper functioning of the piston rings is essential for engine efficiency and performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Functions of Piston Rings:**

 
 
• Sealing the combustion chamber to maintain compression.
 
• Aiding in heat dissipation from the piston to the cylinder wall.
 
• Controlling oil consumption by scraping excess oil.
 
 
 
• **Types of Piston Rings:**
 
 
• Compression Rings: These provide a seal to prevent gas leakage.
 
• Oil Control Rings: These regulate the amount of oil on the cylinder walls.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Maintenance:**
 
 
• Regular inspection and replacement of worn-out rings are necessary to prevent engine damage.
 
• Proper lubrication and engine tuning enhance the longevity of piston rings.
